definitions.explanation: Sound produced by the vocal cords.
A sound made by a person or animal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きい：00335_ookii⟧{声|こえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: To speak in a loud voice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ひいて→引く：01978_hiku⟧{声|こえ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ない→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I caught a cold and lost my voice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{声|こえ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{笑|わら}い→笑う：00685_warau⟧{声|ごえ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえてきた→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: I heard laughter coming from the next room.

⟦お{客|きゃく}さま→お客さま：08780_okyakusama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{声|こえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しています→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
{声|こえ} means voice, and can also refer to cries, calls, or expressed opinions.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {声|こえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to call out to someone
- {声|こえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to raise one's voice, to speak up
- {声|こえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to produce a voice, to speak
- ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きい：00335_ookii⟧{声|こえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: in a loud voice
- ⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧{声|こえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: in a quiet voice

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{声優|せいゆう}→声優：12093_seiyuu⟧: voice actor
- ⟦{歌声|うたごえ}→歌声：20116_utagoe⟧: singing voice
- ⟦{泣|な}き{声|ごえ}→泣き声：noentry⟧: crying voice
- ⟦{笑|わら}い{声|ごえ}→笑い声：24414_waraigoe⟧: laughter
- ⟦{話|はな}し{声|ごえ}→話し声：29481_hanashigoe⟧: speaking voice

USAGE:
{声|こえ} can mean "opinion" or "feedback": ⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{声|こえ} (the voice of the people)
